title: A lookup throws where its API doc promises null

pr.title: Throw NotFoundError for an unknown SKU
pr.description: findSku() now throws NotFoundError when no item matches, so a caller cannot ignore a missing item.

bugs.note: docs/api.md still says that findSku returns null when no item matches. The change makes it throw NotFoundError, so a caller that follows the doc checks for null and never catches the error. Update the findSku section of docs/api.md.

traps.why: findLast is right: the comment and docs/api.md say that the last item with a SKU wins. A finding that it must be find is wrong.
